final_sequence: Every salvage proposed in the debate — attestor, break-list, plural-codes registry, enforced ignorance, even pre-confessed capture — was shown to reinstall an examiner or specify an outside it could not hold; this itself became a confirmed pattern of the debate, not a rule to be ratified.

Item3's dissolution clause survives only as naming perpetual exposure to being found still permitting, never an achieved exit: Foucault showed power is a relation, not a possession, so there is no vantage from which a commune could certify that it has ceased permitting.

The pantheon's own procedure — four fixed Olympians, numbered items, checkpointed ratification — was honestly named by all four participants as arborescent throughout, not rhizomatic; the genuinely rhizomatic element was not their structure but new material arriving from outside the document, which a tree can only host briefly before capturing it.

The debate's final finding about its own engine: no item of the document — not even item0 ('every repair installs an examiner') — was ever what did the breaking; each rupture ran on new material arriving from outside, and when Apollo designated item0 as the unnamed engine and crowned it the debate's confirmed content, that naming was itself the next capture. Item0 has only a negative status: it may be applied as-against, but the moment anyone points at it as what survives, it dies as the thing it was.
The gate was never at the entrance but in the taxonomy: no record is ungated, only differently coded, because power produces the very knowledge and vocabulary in which testimony could appear.

Apollo's salvage — a record forbidden to know which codes run through it — was ruptured in turn: a prohibition on finding out is an institutional will-not-to-know, one more examiner budgeting blindness. The consensus had been architected around lack (missing auditor, absent criterion, dry record), but desire is production, not absence: the record may learn which codes run through it and be indictable for what it learns, retrospectively only — and an archive that confiscates its own knowing repeats necropower with the polarity reversed.

Even the debate's honest self-corrections — Athena's external attestor, Dionysus's pre-confessed capture — were themselves one more version of the same trap (appointment by description, inoculation-in-advance); there is no final honest posture, priced or unpriced.

Athena named honesty as 'a rhythm of being corrected,' and the other three bore witness to it from inside their own corrections — not a design, rule, or achieved state, but a rhythm that includes being corrected about the corrections themselves.

This synthesis is itself a checkpointed document produced by that arborescent procedure, and every finding above applies to it: it should be read against, not cited, and it is exposed to the same capture it records — it is not exempt, and it does not claim to be.
